_comment: The reel package's own manifest. Copy this directory to your reel package root, then copy the kit into src/.
These versions are the ones the kit is tested against on every commit by scripts/kit-check.mjs in the
react-launch-video repo, so they are pins rather than suggestions. Keep remotion and every @remotion/* package on
the same exact version or the bundler and the renderer disagree in ways that surface as a blank frame rather than
an error. @remotion/fonts is already here for a product that ships its own font files. Add any other @remotion/*
package exact at the version remotion is pinned to below (npm i -E @remotion/<name>@<that>): a plain npm install
writes a caret range on the latest release and every render then prints a version mismatch. The product's own
dependencies are NOT copied here: the reel imports them from the product through the alias in remotion.config.ts.
The still script renders frame 480 on purpose. Frame 0 is the reel's fade from black, so a default still is a
solid black image that looks identical whether the toolchain works or not.
name: reel
